verdict.rationale: Azure CLI is cross-platform, scriptable, installable in Docker/headless environments, supports non-interactive output parsing (--query/JMESPath), and Azure also exposes REST APIs explicitly recommended for unattended/CI/DevOps automation with service-principal/managed-identity auth (no interactive login needed). IaC tools (Bicep, ARM, Terraform) further support fully automated, non-interactive provisioning in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure Pipelines snippets) or independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
